final: WITH event_ratios AS (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(COALESCE(spent, 0)) as total_spent, SUM(COALESCE(amount, 0)) as total_amount FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), event_with_ratio AS (SELECT link_to_event, CASE WHEN total_amount > 0 THEN CAST(total_spent AS REAL) / total_amount ELSE 0 END as spend_ratio FROM event_ratios), avg_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) as overall_avg FROM event_with_ratio) SELECT e.link_to_event, e.spend_ratio, e.spend_ratio / a.overall_avg as relative_ratio FROM event_with_ratio e, avg_ratio a ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
